overview_description.description: Verse Therapy offers online speech therapy services with personalized care plans created by licensed therapists for individuals of all ages. The company collaborates with schools and healthcare professionals to extend its services. The platform allows users to begin therapy without waitlists or referrals, focusing on affordability and ease of access.
